summary: The corrected full-timeline run was stopped after more than eleven minutes because it recomputed six bidirectional flow observations over all 660 frames, including diagnosed stable regions, and therefore failed the infrastructure-cost objective.
evidence: The process passed mask and boolean-ABI preflight and remained in weighted residual consensus at 11 minutes 29 seconds.
The measured risk diagnosis localizes the strongest late robot-layer discontinuities to frames 463-520, 543-625, and 637-659.
Those three windows cover 165 of 660 frames while preserving a full-length output timeline.
lessons: Correspondence consensus is an offline risk-window operator at native resolution unless flow features are cached; recomputing it on stable frames violates the generation-cost objective.
limitations: The interrupted run produced no candidate or quality result.
next_actions: Run the unchanged consensus contract only on diagnosed risk windows and report measured end-to-end throughput.
